text:
Ira Support: Heads up — we're getting a sharp uptick in 5xx from hosted inference starting ~08:12 UTC, customers reporting timeouts and billing spikes.
Alex Eng: seeing the same on dashboards, 5xx rate up to 4.2% across us-east-1 gateway. Traces show upstream auth failing with 502s.
Sam Oncall: any recent rollouts?
Alex Eng: yes, a canary pushed ~08:05 that flipped a routing/config flag: `routing.auth_header_policy=strip-portals` (commit 8f3a1c2).
Kavi Dev: that flag was intended to remove tracing headers for internal sinks, but it looks like it also strips `Authorization` when the header path matches `/v1/hosted/*`.
Ira Support: repro from a customer sample: curl to API returns 502 from auth service, then gateway 503. Logs: `upstream auth: missing bearer token`
Maya PM: customers are seeing billing anomalies because retries escalate token usage — they're hitting rate limits downstream.
Alex Eng: quick check: sample log from proxy: ```ERROR auth_forward: drop Authorization for path /v1/hosted/generate client=acct-1234```. That shouldn't happen.
Sam Oncall: ok, we should rollback canary to stop blast radius. Who can run rollback?
Kavi Dev: I can do a scoped rollback of the flag for the canary slices. Patch: set `routing.auth_header_policy=preserve` for slices with tag `canary-2026-03-17`.
DeployBot: Rolling back config flag for slices: canary-2026-03-17 -> progress 0/3 clusters.
Alex Eng: also need to revoke the faulty parsing rule in router: `strip-portals` was applied via selector `route.path_prefix == '/v1/hosted'` which is too broad. Change to `route.path_prefix == '/v1/internal'` in follow-up.
Ira Support: collecting repro steps for customer support notes: 1) example request id 8a7f-cc2b, 2) sample curl: `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/hosted/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' -v` 3) response shows upstream 502 and header missing.
Sam Oncall: rollback status: DeployBot reports 3/3 clusters rolled back, traffic back to stable. Watching metrics.
Kavi Dev: PR opened to tighten selector and add unit test for header preservation: PR #4728. Also adding an integration test to simulate header passthrough.
Alex Eng: post-rollback metrics: 5xx dropped back under 0.2% in 12 minutes, p95 latency normalized.
Maya PM: notify affected customers with timeline + apology, and note billing adjustments if needed.
Ira Support: will open support tickets with refund plan where usage anomaly detected.
Sam Oncall: next steps: 1) postmortem, include root cause: mis-scoped flag selector + no integration test for header trimming, 2) tighten rollout policy: start canary at 1% and hold 15m with auth smoke tests, 3) add alert for sudden auth-502 spike.
Kavi Dev: adding alert rule: `sum(rate(auth_upstream_502[1m])) by (cluster) > 0.1` -> paging.
DeployBot: Canary rollback completed at 08:26 UTC.
Ira Support: closing loop with customers now. Thanks all. :tada:
Alex Eng: filing the incident ticket and assigning postmortem owners (Kavi + Sam).
